answer: Require every agent to stake a costly, verifiable resource before it can trade — a locked deposit or proven compute work. A fake identity is cheap to spawn, but each clone must pay the same stake, so thousands of sock puppets stop paying. Honest agents earn their stake back with interest, while cheaters lose it; the loss sends a ripple through the attacker's whole swarm, like a forest where cutting one timber weakens the stand but felling the grove costs the logger everything. Newcomers can still wander in — they simply put something real at risk first.
